rows.name: KernelBench
rows.target: NVIDIA CUDA; Triton and other GPU DSLs; ROCm support
rows.size: 250 original tasks: 100 L1 + 100 L2 + 50 L3; later L4 additions
rows.description: Translate PyTorch workloads into correct, faster kernels. Reports correctness, speedup and fast_p; pin the benchmark version.
rows.access: MIT repository with workload definitions, input generators and evaluation code. External model dependencies may have separate terms.

rows.name: TritonBench (THUNLP)
rows.size: 350 operators across G and T sets
rows.description: Generate Triton from descriptions or PyTorch. Measures execution correctness and performance against references.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository publishes data and tests. Different project from Meta's similarly named tritonbench.

rows.name: ComputeEval
rows.target: NVIDIA CUDA, CUTLASS, CuTe DSL, cuTile
rows.size: 591 tasks in dataset release 2026.2; earlier releases smaller
rows.description: CUDA programming correctness and performance; includes runtime/library tasks as well as kernels.
rows.access: Data: NVIDIA Evaluation Dataset License, evaluation only; training and redistribution restricted. Harness: Apache-2.0. Public does not mean open-source data.

rows.name: BackendBench
rows.description: Build replacement backends; checks many cases using OpInfo/FACTO and measures representative model shapes.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause repository includes task and test-generation infrastructure; there is no single static text-only test set.

rows.name: MultiKernelBench
rows.target: CUDA, Triton, AscendC, Pallas, MUSA, TileLang, SYCL
rows.description: Tests kernel generation across different accelerator programming ecosystems; current repository expands backend support.
rows.access: MIT task and evaluation repository. Hardware/toolchains must be obtained separately.

rows.name: robust-kbench
rows.description: Harder numerical, input-distribution and forward/backward checks to expose brittle or exploited evaluations.
rows.access: Apache-2.0; public task definitions and validators. Overlaps KernelBench; not an independent pool of all-new tasks.

rows.name: FlashInfer-Bench
rows.description: Correctness and speed on inference kernels with real workload traces and production integration.
rows.access: Harness and flashinfer-trace dataset explicitly Apache-2.0.

rows.name: SOL-ExecBench
rows.size: Versioned subsets: L1, L2, Quantization and FlashInfer-Bench
rows.description: Evaluates generated kernels using correctness, speed and estimated hardware speed-of-light efficiency.
rows.access: Data uses NVIDIA Evaluation Dataset License: evaluation only, with training/redistribution restrictions. Apache-2.0 harness is separate.

rows.name: CUDABench (CUDA-Bench)
rows.size: Multi-level task set; total not independently confirmed
rows.description: Text-to-CUDA generation with references, correctness tests and hardware-performance analysis.
rows.access: Prompts, references and tests are published as CUDABench-Set.jsonl. A clear dataset license was not verified.

rows.name: TritonGym
rows.target: Triton; Gluon and TLX transfer tasks
rows.description: Tests iterative tool-assisted kernel development, generalization and transfer to unfamiliar DSLs.
rows.access: MIT; public task definitions, standardized tools and evaluators.

rows.name: KernelBench-X / KernelBenchX
rows.description: Correctness, hardware efficiency and precision/quantization-aware kernel generation.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository; benchmark also published on Hugging Face.

rows.name: FastKernels
rows.description: Progresses from individual operators through fused blocks to whole inference pipelines; validates outputs and actual end-to-end speed.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository. Current site count may differ from older paper snapshots; model assets have their own terms.

rows.name: Atrex-Bench
rows.target: NVIDIA and AMD; Triton, Gluon, FlyDSL, CuTe DSL
rows.description: Uses serving traces and workload importance to weight correctness and speed-of-light-relative performance.
rows.access: Apache-2.0; public operator definitions, shapes and evaluation framework.

rows.name: AgentKernelArena (AKA)
rows.target: AMD GPUs; HIP, Triton, Gluon, FlyDSL
rows.size: Evolving kernel and end-to-end task packages
rows.description: Agents optimize kernels against high-precision references, explicit baselines and controlled timing.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository includes workloads, references, baselines and evaluation code.

rows.name: GEAK evaluation sets
rows.description: Evaluation workloads introduced with the GEAK agent; not every GEAK release is a new benchmark.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 current repository primarily documents the evolving agent. Historical benchmark versions need to be pinned; full original corpus availability not revalidated.

rows.name: KernelGenBench
rows.target: Triton; NVIDIA, Ascend, MUSA, Hygon, Iluvatar, MetaX
rows.description: Generates kernels for multiple operator sources and checks hardware portability and performance.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 task/evaluation repository. MS and MC overlap; do not add them as 320 independent operators.

rows.name: KernelBench-Verified
rows.description: Revisits numerical checks, TF32 baselines, input distributions and runtime/memory measurement.
rows.access: MIT repository includes validation tests. Named hidden tests are hidden from the agent protocol, not necessarily from download.

rows.name: RealisticTritonBench
rows.size: Real pull-request task set; count not confirmed
rows.description: Bug fixes, new operators and optimization with framework integration and end-to-end validation.
rows.access: Public problems.json, task folders and execution environments; explicit data reuse license not verified.

rows.name: ParallelKernelBench
rows.description: Replace distributed PyTorch/NCCL computations; checks per-rank outputs and communication/computation performance.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository; published problem set and evaluators.

rows.name: NPUEval
rows.description: Generate kernels for an NPU; checks compilation, execution correctness and performance.
rows.access: Task data and code are public. A clear root/data license was not verified in this audit.

rows.name: NPUKernelBench
rows.description: Compilation and numerical validation of generated Ascend kernels, with performance evaluation support.
rows.access: README declares Apache-2.0; public benchmark/operator code. License declaration verified, separate license file not retrieved.

rows.name: CANN Bench
rows.target: Huawei Ascend; AscendC and supported DSLs
rows.description: Operator implementation, compilation, correctness and speed on Ascend hardware.
rows.access: Public under CANN Open Software License Agreement 2.0. Custom license; not treated here as an unrestricted standard open-source data license.

rows.name: AscendKernelBench (AKG)
rows.size: Task corpus within AKG; total not confirmed
rows.description: Benchmark suite associated with AKG's agent-based Ascend kernel generation.
rows.access: AKG repository is Apache-2.0 and names this suite. Full standalone benchmark release and stable manifest were not independently verified.

rows.name: NKIBench
rows.description: Optimize accelerator kernels while matching reference behavior; profiles latency and hardware efficiency.
rows.access: Hugging Face dataset explicitly Apache-2.0; AccelOpt supplies the associated optimization/evaluation tooling.

rows.name: JAXBench
rows.description: Generate TPU kernels and compare correctness and runtime against JAX/XLA and Pallas references.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 accelerator-agents repository includes the benchmark. TPU access is separate.

rows.name: MobileKernelBench
rows.description: Generate optimized mobile inference kernels from Python/ONNX specifications. This is not a mobile-GPU-only suite.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository publishes task assets; an additional dataset mirror is linked.

rows.name: EdgeKernelBench
rows.target: TVM / edge devices including mobile GPUs
rows.description: Assesses graph-, tensor- and device-level optimization under edge deployment constraints.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 release with third-party license notices; retain upstream terms for imported tasks.

rows.name: MetaKernelBench
rows.description: Tests whether kernel-optimization knowledge transfers between DSLs and task families.
rows.access: 32 tasks ship under Apache-2.0; 42 require the user's separately obtained SOL-ExecBench data and its restricted terms.

rows.name: D2K-Bench
rows.description: Tests translating expert kernel designs into executable, efficient implementations; scores design and code aspects.
rows.access: Public task dataset and code; explicit benchmark-data license not verified.

rows.name: Metal-Sci
rows.description: Generate scientific kernels with multiple problem sizes, held-out size checks, CPU references and roofline-aware performance.
rows.access: Public tasks and harness. Root license not verified; do not assume that public source grants reuse rights.

rows.name: HPCAgent-Bench
rows.target: C, C++, Fortran, CUDA, HIP, Python
rows.description: Translate and optimize numerical computations across languages, with correctness judging and performance measurement.
rows.access: GPL-3.0-or-later repository; imported tasks may retain additional upstream notices.

rows.name: MSKernelBench
rows.description: Covers algebra, LLM, sparse and scientific workloads with generated-code examples.
rows.access: Public interactive demo and examples found; complete standardized task data and evaluation harness not verified.

rows.name: KernelCraft
rows.target: Custom assembly / accelerator targets, including PLENA
rows.size: 23 ML tasks on project page; configurations multiply cases
rows.description: Tests kernels for specialized targets using target documentation, simulation and hardware evaluation.
rows.access: Project page explicitly labels code as coming soon. Public paper is not a released benchmark dataset.

rows.name: CUDAHercules / CUDA-Hercules
rows.size: 194 tasks in current release; paper catalog differs
rows.description: Expert-referenced single kernels, kernel families, applications and frontier challenges; correctness and expert-relative speed.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository publishes task manifest, runners, fixtures and input-preparation scripts. Some application inputs/dependencies are fetched separately.

rows.name: KernelBench-v3 (Infatoshi community)
rows.description: Independent community evaluation suite; not an official third major release of Stanford KernelBench.
rows.access: MIT archive; active development moved into kernelbench.com monorepo. Pin the hardware-specific snapshot.

rows.name: KernelBench-Hard (Infatoshi)
rows.size: 6 active problem families in inspected documentation
rows.description: Hard kernels compared with expert implementations and hardware limits; quantized GEMM, attention, MoE and related workloads.
rows.access: MIT archive; active benchmark in kernelbench.com monorepo. Task set evolves.

rows.name: Kernel Arena: WaferBench / KernelBenchHIP
rows.description: Community CUDA/AMD kernel evaluations reported by Wafer.
rows.access: Indexed repository/results evidence found, but live repository returned 404 during verification. Full data availability and license unresolved.

rows.name: GPU MODE kernel competitions
rows.target: NVIDIA / AMD; includes distributed and low-precision tracks
rows.description: Human and agent kernel optimization against released task specifications, reference implementations and tests.
rows.access: reference-kernels now uses June 9 Researcher Reciprocity License; model-improvement use has special requirements. Pin release and check track-specific terms.

rows.name: ParEval
rows.target: CUDA, HIP, OpenMP, MPI and other parallel models
rows.size: Problem set with multiple programming-model variants
rows.description: Evaluates functional correctness and performance of generated parallel programs; broader than deep-learning kernels.
rows.access: MIT repository publishes prompts, drivers, tests and performance infrastructure.

rows.name: KernelShift
rows.target: AArch64 NEON, SVE, SVE2, SME2; Graviton / Apple
rows.description: Agents optimize real-model kernels against expert implementations using compilation, testing and profiling tools.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause harness is public. Referenced arm-bench/KernelShift dataset returned unauthorized/unavailable during inspection; dataset terms not verified.

rows.name: CodegenBench
rows.description: Tests efficient parallel code generation and generalization to less common CPU architectures.
rows.access: Paper links anonymous code and data releases; browser could not inspect their content or license. Public-release claim is author-reported.

rows.name: PopcornBench
rows.target: GPU; A100 to H100; single and multi-GPU
rows.description: Scientific domains outside standard ML operators; architecture migration and randomized-shape validation.
rows.access: Author project links a public MIT KernelBench fork, but top-level README resembles upstream. Full availability of every new scientific and translation track was not independently verified.

rows.name: KernelGen 1P (OpenAI internal)
rows.description: Long-horizon kernel implementation and optimization; correctness, baseline speed and adherence to intended execution path.
rows.access: System cards describe the evaluation; task dataset, hardware environment and harness are not publicly released there.

rows.name: Anthropic Internal Suite 1: kernel optimization
rows.size: Variants; no released fixed public corpus
rows.description: Internal research-engineering evaluation measuring kernel speedup; includes a difficult variant.
rows.access: Public system cards report the task/results, not a complete reusable benchmark dataset or harness.

rows.name: CUDABeaver
rows.description: Repair broken CUDA kernels; complements generation evaluations by testing diagnosis and fixes.
rows.access: CC-BY-4.0 released benchmark, with buggy code, references and testbenches.

rows.name: CASS-Bench
rows.description: Cross-architecture source/assembly translation, rather than unrestricted kernel design.
rows.access: Public repository and Hugging Face dataset. Harness is MIT; independent data license not verified.

rows.name: HPCTransEval (HPCTransCompile)
rows.description: Tests preservation of semantics and efficiency when transpiling high-performance code across architectures.
rows.access: Public benchmark/training artifacts and scripts; clear data license not verified. HPCTransCompile is the associated method.

rows.name: Xpiler-eval (QiMeng-Xpiler)
rows.description: Translation between accelerator/compiler programming systems; related to portability rather than from-scratch generation.
rows.access: Public benchmarks directory and execution scripts; explicit data license not verified.

rows.name: ParBench
rows.description: Tests code translation among parallel programming APIs and functional correctness.
rows.access: MIT benchmark repository; respect upstream source-suite licenses.

rows.name: ParEval-Repo
rows.description: Tests larger parallel-code changes that go beyond the function-level ParEval setting.
rows.access: Task repositories and tests are public; blanket benchmark-data license not verified.

rows.name: TileBench
rows.description: Standardized kernel implementation/profiling across DSLs; useful for generated-kernel comparisons but not wholly new tasks.
rows.access: Public operators and measurement infrastructure; root license not verified.

rows.name: AutoTuneBench
rows.target: Serving systems and MLX kernel workloads
rows.description: Evaluates agents tuning parameters and systems; overlaps kernel optimization but does not require kernel synthesis in every task.
rows.access: MIT task and evaluation repository.

rows.name: PassBench (PassNet)
rows.size: Evaluation tasks separate from large training subgraph corpus
rows.description: Generates optimization passes and measures downstream correctness and performance.
rows.access: Code and subgraph data published; explicit benchmark data license not verified. Training-subgraph counts are not evaluation task counts.

rows.name: ISO-Bench
rows.description: Agent performance patches compared with human changes; may involve kernels, scheduling or other serving components.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 repository; task dataset also published separately. Upstream repository terms apply.

rows.name: RE-Bench
rows.target: GPU / Triton plus broader ML engineering
rows.size: 7 tasks; kernel optimization is a subset
rows.description: Includes low-level performance engineering such as Triton cumulative-sum optimization among broader research tasks.
rows.access: MIT public task release; some environments require separate model/service dependencies. Repository now marks benchmark deprecated.

rows.name: gpuFLOPBench
rows.description: Predict operation counts from source without executing it; tests understanding rather than writing a fast kernel.
rows.access: MIT dataset-generation, profiling and evaluation repository; upstream notices retained.

rows.name: kernel-fingerprinting
rows.description: Tests behavior across inputs and configurations; useful for auditing whether optimized kernels generalize.
rows.access: MIT code and experiment artifacts; this is a validation study/toolkit rather than a standard generation leaderboard.

rows.name: KernelAudit
rows.description: Audits semantic correctness, implementation rules and timing integrity; measures validators, not just generator pass rate.
rows.access: Paper inspected; advertised public repository could not be retrieved. Do not infer public data from the paper license.

rows.name: KernelMutate
rows.description: Tests generated-kernel validators using controlled faults, stress inputs and replacement obligations.
rows.access: Paper is public; a complete accessible candidate corpus and reuse license were not verified.

rows.name: KernelBook
rows.description: Useful for training or constructing held-out evaluations; using it directly as a test set risks train/test overlap.
rows.access: Current dataset uses June 9 Researcher Reciprocity License with conditions on model-improvement use, plus upstream repository terms.

rows.name: QiMeng-TensorOp released examples
rows.target: RISC-V C920V2 / SGEMM in inspected release
rows.size: Public SGEMM example; broader paper study
rows.description: Examples accompanying a tensor-operator optimization method, not a verified complete independent benchmark release.
rows.access: Public benchmark guide and examples found; complete paper evaluation corpus and license not verified.

rows.name: EvalPerf
rows.description: Performance-sensitive evaluation built on HumanEval+/MBPP+ with efficiency inputs and speed-based scoring.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 EvalPlus project provides evaluation tooling and release assets; retain original task notices.

rows.name: ENAMEL
rows.description: Uses strong reference solutions and demanding inputs to assess execution efficiency as well as correctness.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 code; public generated tests and samples on Hugging Face. Separate dataset licensing was not fully verified.

rows.name: EffiBench
rows.description: Runtime and memory efficiency relative to human canonical solutions; mostly algorithmic rather than hardware kernels.
rows.access: Public tasks/evaluation code and dataset. Explicit reuse terms for all problem statements and solutions not verified.

rows.name: EffiBench-X
rows.description: Compares correctness, runtime and memory across languages and coding platforms.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 code and public dataset; inherited task-content terms need separate verification.

rows.name: Mercury
rows.description: Efficiency-oriented synthesis with generated test cases; not GPU-specific.
rows.access: Public repository and dataset; explicit full data reuse license not verified.

rows.name: PIE / PIE-Perf
rows.description: Optimize an existing program while preserving behavior; separates optimization from specification-to-code synthesis.
rows.access: Public data links and tooling; CodeNet and source-problem terms must be checked. Training corpus size is not test-set size.

rows.name: SWE-Perf
rows.description: Produce correctness-preserving performance patches from real optimization pull requests.
rows.access: Public task dataset and evaluation code; underlying repositories have their own licenses.

rows.name: SWE-fficiency
rows.description: Optimizes real workloads with correctness tests kept separate from performance workloads; compares with expert changes.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 project publishes tasks, containers and evaluators; upstream project licenses apply.

rows.name: GSO
rows.description: Global Software Optimization evaluates speed improvements against expert performance patches.
rows.access: MIT project with published dataset and containers; inherited repository terms remain relevant.

rows.name: PolyBench/C
rows.description: Static-control numerical kernels used as optimization and translation substrates; not originally an LLM evaluation.
rows.access: Source and input-generation code downloadable; exact chosen release/license should be pinned.

rows.name: PolyBench/GPU
rows.description: Useful reference kernels for GPU translation and optimization studies; no native LLM scoring protocol.
rows.access: Public source; release-specific and upstream license notices should be checked.

rows.name: PolyBench-ACC
rows.description: Accelerator ports used to compare compilers and programming models.
rows.access: BSD-style redistribution license in public repository; preserve source notices.

rows.name: Rodinia
rows.description: Representative compute patterns for optimization and translation; not an LLM-specific benchmark.
rows.access: BSD-style source license. Input datasets are separate downloads; the linked source mirror documents them.

rows.name: Parboil
rows.description: Scientific/media kernels and applications used for hardware/compiler evaluation and as translation tasks.
rows.access: Illinois/NCSA open-source license in linked mirror; input datasets may require separate retrieval.

rows.name: SHOC
rows.description: Device performance primitives and application kernels; useful calibration workloads.
rows.access: BSD-style source license; public benchmark suite.

rows.name: HeCBench
rows.description: A major source of parallel translation, performance reasoning and generated-kernel evaluation workloads.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause project with upstream notices. Some tasks require external inputs/dependencies.

rows.name: NPBench
rows.description: Compares compiler/backend implementations; useful source computations for LLM kernel generation.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause repository with public benchmark definitions and input initialization.

rows.name: NAS Parallel Benchmarks (NPB)
rows.description: Parallel scientific computing workloads; compare generated implementations against validated references.
rows.access: NASA distributes reference implementations and problem classes; verify license of selected version/port.

rows.name: XSBench / RSBench
rows.description: Nuclear cross-section lookup workloads used in optimization and porting studies.
rows.access: MIT source and synthetic input generation; grouped as related miniapplications, not one standardized LLM suite.

rows.name: LULESH
rows.description: Proxy application for correctness-preserving scientific optimization and parallelization.
rows.access: Public source and problem setup; release-specific license was not checked in this audit.

rows.name: BabelStream
rows.description: Measures memory bandwidth; useful microkernel targets and hardware baselines, not a generator benchmark by itself.
rows.access: Public code with license file; exact license conditions not fully audited here.

rows.name: TorchBench
rows.description: Whole-model performance and regression tests; can validate downstream benefit of generated kernels.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause infrastructure; individual models, datasets and weights can have separate access/license requirements.

rows.name: TritonBench (Meta/PyTorch)
rows.description: Compares operator implementation performance. Distinct from THUNLP's LLM-generation TritonBench.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause public operator and benchmark code.

rows.name: DeepBench
rows.size: GEMM, convolution, recurrent and communication workloads
rows.description: Deep-learning primitive performance baselines and workload shapes; not originally model-generated code evaluation.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 benchmark source and workload descriptions.

rows.name: CUTLASS profiler / examples
rows.description: High-performance references and profiling infrastructure for GEMM/convolution kernel evaluations; not a standalone LLM task corpus.
rows.access: BSD-3-Clause code; generated problem configurations and examples public.

rows.name: SuiteSparse Matrix Collection
rows.description: Real sparse inputs useful for kernel correctness/performance and workload diversity.
rows.access: Public collection normally downloadable, but official site currently says matrix downloads are offline. Dataset-specific terms not fully audited.

rows.name: MLPerf Inference
rows.description: Checks whether system-level inference speed and quality improve; does not directly isolate kernel-writing ability.
rows.access: Apache-2.0 harness; weights and datasets have separate terms/access. Not all evaluation assets are one open-source package.

rows.name: SPEC ACCEL / SPECaccel
rows.description: Traditional accelerator performance evaluation; possible external workload source, not an LLM-generation benchmark.
rows.access: Licensed commercial benchmark package; public results/specifications do not make the full task package open source.

rows.name: SparseKernelBench
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Listed in benchmark catalogs; primary OpenReview content and public data release could not be verified.

rows.name: QKernelBench
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Primary submission access failed; task count, evaluation design and data license remain unverified.

rows.name: Megakernelbench
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Catalog-discovered submission; public benchmark package not verified.

rows.name: SWE-KERNEL-BENCH
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Do not assume similarly named SWE-Kernel repositories are the same release; author/repository mapping not verified.

rows.name: SciKernelBench
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Name corroborated in research announcements, but advertised GitHub release was inaccessible and dataset licensing remains unverified.

rows.name: KernelBench-MUSA / MooreEval
rows.description: Discovery lead only; not counted as a verified benchmark release.
rows.access: Catalog lead points to a DSL repository, not a verified standalone benchmark manifest. Kept out of the confirmed benchmark table.
